text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With only a few days left of the training 
camp, the Umamusume were sweating it out 
as if kicking into their final sprint.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's do 5 round trips on 
the beach. Focus on finishing the run 
rather than your time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. ......I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Right, finishing the whole menu is what's 
important. If you push too hard and 
neglect the second half, the balance of 
the menu itself will fall apart.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"You're right...! I'll continue to be very 
careful from now on!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, and so, if you wouldn't mind, I'd 
love to hear your thoughts on my next 
training session...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing that day's training, 
Trainers were exchanging thoughts and 
opinions.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The training camp will be ending soon... 
And right after that, the real autumn 
races will begin, won't they?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Both Bitter Glace and Little Cocon 
were able to have a fulfilling training 
camp.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Trainer Kiryuin was 
quite fired up as well, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
You were watching!? Ahaha... I feel a bit 
embarrassed, thinking I might have gotten 
a little too carried away...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Still, seeing how Meek has grown lately, 
I'm genuinely feeling the payoff!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It might be a small step compared to 
others, but we're both just so happy to be 
moving forward...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The true budding is surely yet to come. We 
pledged to keep doing our best together 
like thisââ

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of us actually came up 
with a goal together!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That is... "To conquer a graded race 
before the year ends"!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I don't intend to rush, but 
having a goal keeps my spirits up.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Besides... with the support of the Three 
Goddesses, I don't think it's an 
impossible goal at all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Strum ♪)

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me... Ah, it's from Darley Arabian. 
I was just asking her about the menu.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"Cardiopulmonary enhancement via hill 
training," 89% compatibility... 
"Comprehensive conditioning in the pool," 
33% compatibility...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon's training menu?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was given the optimal training 
regimen for my first race of the autumn.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
As time passes and the Umamusume grow, 
data is updated and the precision of our 
support increases.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...The Three Goddesses truly bring us 
closer to our goals, don't they?"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Right...! All right, I'm going to ask 
Godolphin Barb about Meek again...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the knowledge of the Three 
Goddesses, the trainers have been 
achieving unparalleled results.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Their support was so reliable that calling 
it a godsend felt almost too convenient.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
............ ...Fufu, my time improved 
today too...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
GOOOAL!! The time is... 85 seconds flat! 
Final stretch was 12.5!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Fuhee~... I completely ran out of steam on 
the final furlong! 85.8 seconds~!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...I'm okay. ...Just keep to my own pace, 
my own pace.
